name: Dolphin Blue Vita
author: Tobic-99
description: A static recompilation of Dolphin Blue (Sammy, Atomiswave) to native ARM code. The game's SH-4 code is translated to C++ and linked with a native runtime that replaces the hardware: the PowerVR2 tile accelerator (rendered with GXM), the AICA sound chip (its ARM7 sound driver and DSP programs are translated as well), the GD-ROM and the BIOS calls. There is no emulator, interpreter or JIT on the hot paths.
